name: workspace-timing 自动化审查规则注册表（唯一事实源）
description: L0语法构建 / L1代码质量(由tsc+eslint承载) / L2结构 / L3工程治理与资源拓扑 / L4性能 / L5重构审查。规则ID命名空间：LAY-结构 HC-硬编码 SCR-脚本规范 RCFG-审查配置 RES-资源拓扑 PERF-性能 TB-测试预算 ARF-auto-refactor 映射

gate.strict: ALL 非 PASS 状态（含 SKIP/NOT_AVAILABLE）一律阻断，供 CI 使用
gate.default: FAIL/CONFIG_ERROR/TIMEOUT 阻断；SKIP/NOT_AVAILABLE 降级放行但必须在报告中显式标注

checkers.title: Static code quality through the full eslint rule set

ruleTitles.L1-*: Dynamic namespace for generated eslint rule identifiers

checkers.title: Layer dependency matrix conformance and import cycle freedom

ruleTitles.LAY-CYCLE: Import cycle across the dependency graph
ruleTitles.LAY-UNRESOLVED: Relative import not resolvable to a declared layer

checkers.title: Hardcoded path, UI string, secret and magic number checks

ruleTitles.HC-ABS-PATH: Hardcoded absolute path or file URI literal
ruleTitles.HC-UI-STRING: Host message API call with a string literal bypassing i18n
ruleTitles.HC-CJK-LITERAL: Inline CJK literal inside the presentation layer
ruleTitles.HC-SECRET: Credential or secret pattern embedded in source
ruleTitles.HC-MAGIC-NUM: Numeric literal outside an exempt constant home

checkers.title: Script naming, header contract and registry completeness

ruleTitles.SCR-NAMING: Script file name deviates from kebab-case
ruleTitles.SCR-HEADER: Script header contract missing a mandatory tag
ruleTitles.SCR-ORPHAN: Checker script absent from the review registry
ruleTitles.SCR-DANGLING: Registry entry pointing at a missing checker file

checkers.title: Changelog and README text layout contracts

ruleTitles.DOC-CL-001: Changelog lacks an Unreleased accumulation section
ruleTitles.DOC-CL-002: Version heading format or descending order violation
ruleTitles.DOC-CL-003: Latest changelog version out of sync with package manifest
ruleTitles.DOC-CL-004: Section heading outside the standard category table
ruleTitles.DOC-CL-005: Change entry without a bold lead-in phrase
ruleTitles.DOC-CL-006: Invalid or future-dated version release date
ruleTitles.DOC-CL-007: Changelog cites a nonexistent code symbol or setting
ruleTitles.DOC-CL-008: Internal jargon or math notation in release notes
ruleTitles.DOC-CL-009: Engineering process wording in product release notes
ruleTitles.DOC-RD-001: README missing a required section anchor
ruleTitles.DOC-RD-002: Released version absent from or stale in the README roadmap
ruleTitles.DOC-RD-003: Roadmap summary citing fabricated settings or jargon

ruleTitles.RCFG-SCHEMA: Registry schema, required field or origin validation breach
ruleTitles.RCFG-MATRIX: Dependency matrix mapping or layer reference invalid
ruleTitles.RCFG-RULE-DRIFT: Declared rule without implementation or undeclared finding
ruleTitles.RCFG-GLOBS: Tool scan glob matching zero files
ruleTitles.RCFG-TOOL-PATH: Adapter tool path, timeout or report contract problem

checkers.title: Structured resource naming topology and split fitness

ruleTitles.RES-TOPO-OVER-GENERIC: Oversized single-tier resource file needing a domain split
ruleTitles.RES-TOPO-OVER-SPECIALIZED: Three-tier resource file below the fragmentation floor
ruleTitles.RES-TOPO-NAMING-DEPTH: Resource file name exceeding three naming tiers
ruleTitles.RES-TOPO-OVER-DESCRIPTIVE: Resource file name piling more than four tokens
ruleTitles.RES-TOPO-RESP-MISMATCH: Resource file mixing executable logic below purity floor

ruleTitles.L0-TEST: Failing unit test case in the suite

checkers.title: Test suite duration budget regression ratchet

ruleTitles.TB-REGRESSION: Test suite duration exceeding its baseline budget
ruleTitles.TB-NO-BASELINE: No duration baseline recorded, regression undecidable

checkers.consumeNote: 编排器将 L0-TEST 的实测时长经 --consume-duration 复用，避免同一套件在同轮审查中重复执行

checkers.title: External structural refactor scan via an isolated adapter

ruleTitles.ARF-*: Dynamic namespace for adapter-mapped external findings

layers.comment: 依赖矩阵：src/ 五层 + i18n + 入口的 import 许可。语义见 scripts/README.md。集成层禁止依赖应用层/展现层（2026-09 审查修复项已固化）。
layers.matchingSemantics: mayImportExternal 条目：'src/x/*' 前缀匹配文件；'src/integration/logger' 精确文件；'i18n'（无/无*）整层匹配。persistence→src/cache/IJournalStore 为依赖倒置端口实现（消费方接口），属许可的例外。

magicNumber.comment: 结构性常量豁免：domain/models.ts 是项目唯一常量家园；模板文件、样式文件与测试不在扫描面；0/1/2 等计数基元不判违规
